P958 reading queue

226 shrines across 140 Kokugakuin pages. Their P958 section is the index of their 現社名など（N） block on the Kokugakuin page, and there is nothing in Wikidata to derive it from — so it has to be read off the source.

Each card shows every item on that page, so the sections already taken are visible while choosing. Type a number (or n/a) into a yellow row and the QuickStatements line builds at the bottom.

Nothing here edits anything, and nothing tracks whether you have done any of it. Submission waits on the Wikidata lockout to 2026-09-18.
